title: Illustration / Line style — Design

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; interactive elements retain their captured state

slide_intent: Control line weight, spacing and curvature so detailed drawings remain clear and look deliberately constructed.
strategic_value: A shared 4px foundation and disciplined strokes can connect IBM’s varied line illustrations to the same precise visual language.
demonstration: A gallery of line illustrations leads into stroke scales, weight and spacing comparisons, grid alignment, angle and curve construction, and gradient examples.
practical_value: Build line artwork on the prescribed grid, then check that stroke differences and spacing remain intentional.

content_islands.name: Examples
content_islands.spec: Present the gradient spiral, outline finger, circuit, city and technical drawings as the introductory family.

content_islands.name: Stroke logic
content_islands.spec: Show the labeled line-weight scale followed by approved/rejected mixing and spacing comparisons.

content_islands.name: Grid and drawing
content_islands.spec: Pair the illustrated grid with snap-to-grid examples, then show a drawing divided into construction and finished halves.

content_islands.name: Angles and curves
content_islands.spec: Follow with standard-angle rays, circle-derived curves, an organic shoe contour and nested-radius comparisons.

content_islands.name: Color behavior
content_islands.spec: Close with stroke-following gradients and examples that imply transparency through palette choices.

ingredient.name: Line-style grid and strokes
ingredient.role: Keep detailed illustrations precise and visually open.
ingredient.application: Use the 4px grid and snap anchor points to it; make spacing at least equal to the line weight; choose clearly differentiated weights and prefer standard angles.
ingredient.scope: IBM line-style illustrations. Four weights is a recommendation, not an absolute prohibition; organic curves and other angles remain permitted when the concept needs them.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects disciplined lines and grid positioning to lightness, clarity and IBM’s engineered aesthetic.
reference_purposes.Expression: The examples show the recognizable line-based treatment across abstract and literal subjects.
reference_purposes.Application: Construction diagrams teach grid snapping, stroke separation and curve construction.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The line-style grid is 4px for all canvas sizes; spacing must be at least the line weight. The source recommends no more than four weights and permits nonstandard angles or organic curves when justified.
